_comment: Random seeds for Urrea (2026), Sensors. Seed 42 is used throughout, matching
the convention stated in the companion papers of this series, so that a reader
comparing P1 and P5 need not wonder whether a discrepancy came from the method
or from the seed. Confirm each entry against your actual run before depositing.
model_init carries one seed per fold of the rotation in src/lso_rotation.py.
